title: Fix: kcapi GCM authsize must match actual taglen at decrypt time
description:
In src/providers/kcapi/kcapi_aead.c, kcapi_aead_sess_init calls crypto_aead_setauthsize(tfm, GCM_TAG_SIZE=16) unconditionally. kcapi_aead_set_tag stores taglen in ctx->taglen but the kernel AEAD transform still has authsize=16. kcapi_aead_decrypt assembles src_buf with only ctx->taglen bytes of tag, but the kernel splits using authsize=16, reading garbage for the last (16-taglen) bytes. Every decrypt with a 12-byte tag returns -EBADMSG.

Fix: remove the crypto_aead_setauthsize call from kcapi_aead_sess_init. Call crypto_aead_setauthsize(ctx->tfm, ctx->taglen) inside both kcapi_aead_encrypt and kcapi_aead_decrypt immediately before aead_request_set_crypt, using the taglen from set_tag. If ctx->taglen == 0 at that point, return -EINVAL.

Verify: test all FIPS-permitted tag sizes (12-16 bytes). Confirm taglen=11 still rejected at set_tag (that check is correct and stays).

Test: add a KAT in tests/userspace using an NIST CAVP AES-GCM vector with a 12-byte tag via the kcapi provider.
close_reason: setauthsize+ctx->authsize update in kcapi_aead_set_tag; 12-byte tag vector v4 added; test loop updated; build clean
